subject: Princess Sara
text: Princess Sara gives the party the Lute after being rescued.

evidence.quote: If you talk to the Princess, she also thanks you for saving her, and gives you the Lute, which she says has been passed down from Queen to Princess for 2000 years and it may come in handy.

subject: Motoya's Cave
text: Motoya's Cave contains two Heal Potions and a Pure Potion.

evidence.quote: Items: Heal Potion x2, Pure Potion

subject: World Map
text: Pressing B and Select simultaneously on the world map opens a map showing current location and towns.

evidence.quote: In fact if you take what it says, "TCELES B HSUP" it is actually means "PUSH B SELECT". By doing so on the world map, it opens up a map of the entire world, showing your current location and all the towns and other places you can enter are shown by flashing dots.

subject: Bikke
text: Defeating Bikke in Pravoka yields his ship for your use.

evidence.quote: Once he is defeated, Bikke says that he's sorry and he hands over his ship for you to use.

subject: Kyzoku
text: Defeating the blue pirate monsters named Kyzoku awards 120 GP per kill.

evidence.quote: If you run across some blue pirate looking monsters (Kyzoku) you should try to kill them since they are worth 120 GP per kill.

subject: Peninsula of Power
text: The top two squares and one square underneath on the peninsula north of the port feature extremely tough monsters that yield several hundred exp and several thousand gold per kill.

evidence.quote: The top two squares on the pennisula and one more underneath it have some EXTREMELY tough monsters here, but if you manage to defeat them, you can net several hundred exp and several thousand gold per kill.
